title: Funds και servicers δεν μπορούν να αποφασίζουν για τη ζωή των δανειοληπτών
summary: NIKH MP Andreas Voryllas intervened in the Economic Affairs Committee to demand withdrawal of Article 23 permitting foreclosure after three missed payments, which was subsequently withdrawn by Minister Markopoulos, and submitted a legislative proposal granting borrowers a right of first refusal before non-performing loan transfers.
speaker: Andreas Voryllas
original_quote: Θα ήθελα να σταθούμε στην τρίτη συνεδρίαση της Επιτροπής Οικονομικών Υποθέσεων, κατά την οποία ζητήσαμε ρητά την απόσυρση του άρθρου 23, το οποίο επέτρεπε τον πλειστηριασμό, αν τρεις συνεχόμενες δόσεις της ρύθμισης παρέμεναν απλήρωτες από τον δανειολήπτη. Ο κ. Μαρκόπουλος ανακοίνωσε την απόσυρσή του, μετά τις αντιδράσεις φορέων και αντιπολίτευσης.
translation: I would like to focus on the third session of the Economic Affairs Committee, during which we explicitly requested the withdrawal of Article 23, which permitted foreclosure if three consecutive installments of the arrangement remained unpaid by the borrower. Mr. Markopoulos announced its withdrawal, following reactions from bodies and the opposition.

title: Funds και servicers δεν μπορούν να αποφασίζουν για τη ζωή των δανειοληπτών

original_quote: Σε αυτή τη συζήτηση η ΝΙΚΗ εισφέρει συγκεκριμένη πρόταση νόμου για προηγούμενο δικαίωμα προτίμησης του δανειολήπτη. Πριν από τη μεταβίβαση μη εξυπηρετούμενης απαίτησης, ο πιστωτής οφείλει να γνωστοποιεί ατομικά το οικονομικό αντάλλαγμα και να προσφέρει στον οφειλέτη δυνατότητα οριστικής εξόφλησης με οικονομικά ισοδύναμους όρους.
translation: In this discussion, NIKH contributes a specific legislative proposal for a prior right of preference for the borrower. Before the transfer of a non-performing claim, the creditor must individually disclose the financial consideration and offer the debtor the possibility of final settlement on economically equivalent terms.

title: VAS Andersson: Amazonin algoritmiseen riistoon tulee puuttua uusilla EU-säännöillä
summary: Left Alliance MEP Li Andersson visited Amazon warehouse facilities in Germany and Poland with the European Parliament's Employment Committee to investigate working conditions and algorithmic management, calling for new EU regulations on algorithmic management and artificial intelligence use in workplaces.
speaker: Li Andersson
original_quote: Osoittautui käytännössä mahdottomaksi saada kunnolla tietoa työn valvontaan ja tehokkuuden seurantaan käytettävien järjestelmien toiminnasta. Työntekijät eivät tiedä, mitä dataa kerätään ja mihin sitä käytetään. Kiristyvät tehokkuusvaatimukset kuitenkin aiheuttavat vaaratilanteita ja kuormitusta. Riisto muuttuu näkymättömäksi, kun sen suorittaa algoritmi.
translation: It proved practically impossible to properly obtain information about the functioning of systems used for work monitoring and efficiency tracking. Workers do not know what data is collected and what it is used for. Tightening efficiency requirements, however, cause dangerous situations and strain. Exploitation becomes invisible when it is carried out by an algorithm.

title: VAS Andersson: Amazonin algoritmiseen riistoon tulee puuttua uusilla EU-säännöillä
summary: Left Alliance MEP Li Andersson visited Amazon warehouse facilities in Germany and Poland with the European Parliament's Employment Committee to investigate working conditions and algorithmic management, calling for new EU regulations on algorithmic management and artificial intelligence use in workplaces.
speaker: Li Andersson
original_quote: Amazonin Bezosin ja Teslan Muskin kaltaisille teknologiajättien johtajille on periaatekysymys, että ammattiliittojen kanssa ei neuvotella. Tässä ajattelussa esimerkiksi palkka ja työehdot kuuluvat työnantajan määräysvaltaan. Samalla kuulimme työntekijöiltä siitä, että liittoon kuuluvia tai lakkoon osallistuvia työntekijöitä painostetaan tai jopa irtisanotaan.
translation: For tech giant leaders like Amazon's Bezos and Tesla's Musk, it is a matter of principle that they do not negotiate with trade unions. In this thinking, for example, wages and working conditions belong to the employer's control. At the same time, we heard from workers that union members or workers participating in strikes are pressured or even dismissed.

title: Pia Lohikoski: Valtiovarainministeriö ajaisi Suomen yhä syvemmin luokkayhteiskuntaan
summary: Left Alliance MP Pia Lohikoski criticized the Ministry of Finance's proposals for public spending cuts, arguing they would push Finland toward a class society by drastically cutting education, research, student grants, and child benefits.

original_quote: On järkyttävää, että valtiovarainministeriön mukaan suomalaisesta koulutuksesta ja tutkimuksesta voitaisiin leikata näin rajusti.
translation: It is shocking that according to the Ministry of Finance, Finnish education and research could be cut so drastically.

title: Pia Lohikoski: Valtiovarainministeriö ajaisi Suomen yhä syvemmin luokkayhteiskuntaan

original_quote: Länsimainen liberaali demokratia lähtee yksilön muodollisesta vapaudesta, mutta vapaus jää helposti tyhjäksi, jos valta omistamisen ja talouden avulla keskitetään vain joidenkin käsiin. translation: Western liberal democracy starts from the individual's formal freedom, but freedom easily becomes empty if power through ownership and economy is concentrated in only some hands. China's socialist system starts more strongly from collective capacity to act and long-term planning

translation: From reading the new chats of Youssef Siher, the presence of a real organization clearly emerges that even advised food and water supplies to those who were called to destroy shop windows and throw 'shit at the cops'.

translation: What we read is sufficient to further investigate Siher's conduct and to re-evaluate his position and the seriousness of the accusation. Words that hint at the hypothesis of terrorism, in the face of which it is justified to overcome any scruple, because defending Italy is a priority.

title: Siher: con nuove chat si rivaluti posizione. Solidarietà a Donzelli per minacce

title: Dehors: regole chiare e tempi dimezzati per imprese
summary: Brothers of Italy senators praise a Council of Ministers decree reorganizing outdoor seating (dehors) regulations, reducing authorization times to 45 days and limiting cultural heritage oversight to areas directly adjacent to exceptional monuments.
actors: Salvo Pogliese; Silvio Giovine; Giorgia Meloni
speaker: Salvo Pogliese
original_quote: Con il via libera del Consiglio dei ministri al decreto di riordino sui dehors, il governo Meloni mette finalmente la parola fine alla stagione delle proroghe emergenziali e dell'incertezza normativa, consegnando a bar, ristoranti e pubblici esercizi una disciplina organica, stabile e moderna.
translation: With the Council of Ministers' approval of the decree reorganizing dehors, the Meloni government finally puts an end to the season of emergency extensions and regulatory uncertainty, delivering to bars, restaurants and public establishments an organic, stable and modern discipline.

translation: Among the main innovations provided: the reduction to 45 days of the terms for issuing cultural and landscape authorizations, the application of tacit consent and the establishment of an information system for the areas concerned.

title: Polizia penitenziaria: piano assunzioni più grande di ultimi 40 anni
summary: Undersecretary of Justice Alberto Balboni announced the largest prison police recruitment plan in 40 years, with hiring in January and February expected to bring staffing close to full capacity, and noted the government renewed the collective contract for officers after 10 years.
speaker: Alberto Balboni
original_quote: Questo governo ha trovato una situazione molto difficile. Dopo oltre 10 anni del blocco del turnover e un ridimensionamento delle scuole di formazione, ci siamo trovati con uno stato del personale difficilissimo da gestire, con un'età media molto elevata.
translation: This government found a very difficult situation. After over 10 years of turnover freeze and a downsizing of training schools, we found ourselves with a very difficult staffing situation to manage, with a very high average age.

title: Polizia penitenziaria: piano assunzioni più grande di ultimi 40 anni
summary: Undersecretary of Justice Alberto Balboni announced the largest prison police recruitment plan in 40 years, with hiring in January and February expected to bring staffing close to full capacity, and noted the government renewed the collective contract for officers after 10 years.
speaker: Alberto Balboni
original_quote: Per questo abbiamo varato il più grande piano assunzionale degli ultimi 40 anni; ciò nonostante siamo ancora sotto organico. Con il reclutamento di gennaio e febbraio ci avvicineremo finalmente alla saturazione della pianta organica.
translation: For this reason we launched the largest recruitment plan of the last 40 years; nevertheless we are still understaffed. With the recruitment in January and February we will finally approach full staffing capacity.

title: Polizia penitenziaria: piano assunzioni più grande di ultimi 40 anni

original_quote: Siamo riusciti a rinnovare dopo 10 anni il contratto collettivo degli agenti, addirittura a luglio abbiamo rinnovato il contratto prima della scadenza, prima volta nella storia della Repubblica.
translation: We managed to renew the collective contract for officers after 10 years, indeed in July we renewed the contract before its expiration, the first time in the history of the Republic.

title: Cortei: scarcerazione Siher mortifica lavoro forze dell’ordine
summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni criticized a Milan judge's decision not to validate the arrest of Youssef Siher, accused of managing a Telegram page that incited protests leading to vandalism in Milan, calling it shameful and a mortification of law enforcement work.
speaker: Giorgia Meloni
original_quote: Lo dirò senza mezzi termini: considero vergognosa la decisione del gip di Milano di non convalidare l'arresto di Youssef Siher, accusato di essere il gestore della pagina Telegram 'Movimento 17 ottobre', cioè la pagina che incitava l'organizzazione di quelle manifestazioni che poi abbiamo visto portare alla devastazione di diversi esercizi commerciali a Milano.
translation: I will say it without mincing words: I consider shameful the decision of the Milan investigating judge not to validate the arrest of Youssef Siher, accused of being the manager of the Telegram page 'Movimento 17 ottobre', that is the page that incited the organization of those demonstrations that we then saw lead to the devastation of several commercial establishments in Milan.

title: Cortei: scarcerazione Siher mortifica lavoro forze dell’ordine
summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni criticized a Milan judge's decision not to validate the arrest of Youssef Siher, accused of managing a Telegram page that incited protests leading to vandalism in Milan, calling it shameful and a mortification of law enforcement work.

original_quote: Penso che questa sia una mortificazione insopportabile del lavoro delle forze dell'ordine, degli inquirenti, del ministero dell'Interno e, in generale, di tutti coloro che si adoperano per difendere la gente per bene dal rischio di vedere devastate le proprie città e i propri esercizi commerciali.
translation: I think this is an unbearable mortification of the work of law enforcement, investigators, the Ministry of the Interior and, in general, of all those who work to defend decent people from the risk of seeing their cities and their commercial establishments devastated.

title: Mafia: arrestato sindaco sinistra che fomentava protesta tir
summary: Brothers of Italy Senator Raoul Russo and party members in the Anti-Mafia Commission commented on the arrest of Corigliano Rossano mayor Flavio Stasi on mafia-related charges, criticizing left-wing parties for their silence and noting Stasi had recently led trucker protests against the Meloni government.
speaker: Raoul Russo
original_quote: Stamane è stata compiuta una vasta azione contro la 'Ndrangheta che, oltre a portare all'arresto di vari esponenti di famiglie mafiose, ha portato anche all'arresto del sindaco di Corigliano Rossano, Flavio Stasi, cui sono state mosse accuse pesantissime, fra cui reati connessi all'immigrazione. Stasi è stato fino a pochi giorni fa impegnato a fianco delle proteste degli autotrasportatori non lesinando attacchi alla premier Meloni. E oggi è stato arrestato. Da parte della sinistra non si è ancora levata nessuna voce quando, per molto meno, questa voce l'hanno fatta sentire. Questa è la dimostrazione che a sinistra hanno la coda di paglia e, come al solito, applicano due pesi e due misure.
translation: This morning a vast action was carried out against the 'Ndrangheta which, in addition to leading to the arrest of various members of mafia families, also led to the arrest of the mayor of Corigliano Rossano, Flavio Stasi, who has been charged with very serious accusations, including crimes related to immigration. Until a few days ago Stasi was engaged alongside the truck drivers' protests, not sparing attacks on Premier Meloni. And today he was arrested. From the left not a single voice has yet been raised when, for much less, they made their voice heard. This is proof that the left has a guilty conscience and, as usual, applies double standards.
